name: John Jacob Kulp
notable_stories: Migrated with his father (a Civil War veteran) to homestead in Washington Territory
He reportedly never knew his exact birth year, which is debated by family researchers

John's birth date is disputed: headstone in Albion Cemetery says 1860, but that would have made his mom Sarah Vancel Kulp only 14 years old. Family members question the date and John didn't seem to know when he was born.
About 1913, John moved his family of seven children and wife Mary to Schragg, WA after Dorothy Kulp Kenoyer was born in 1912. Then moved to Albion, WA.
No one has John Kulp's birth certificate, and one family member said John did not seem to know when he was born.
milestones: Married Mary Emily Valentine McPhail (m. 15 Aug 1897, Lynden, WA)
Moved family to the drier climate of Eastern Washington in 1913 for his wife's health
Married Mary Emily Valentine McPhail (b. 1878 Nashville, TN; d. 31 May 1931 Albion, WA)
Moved family from Whatcom County to Schragg, WA ~1913, then to Albion, WA
Died 11 Jan 1947, Colfax, Whitman Co, Washington
Buried: John Jacob Kulp is buried in the Albion cemetery, where his headstone gives an 1860 birth year.
locations: Albion Cemetery (Guy Albion Pine Cemetery), Albion, Washington
Burk Road, Delta Township, Whatcom County, Washington
sources: Family research emails, 2011–2013 (John and Barbara Adams with Irma Kulp Zacher, George F. Adams, Bill Allen and others)
notes: Siblings listed: Ida, Mary Elizabeth, George Jasper. Compiled family scrapbooks with daughter Dradie around 1943.
Birth year dispute documented. Death confirmed as 11 Jan 1947 in Colfax, Whitman County, WA. Source: Irmagene Kulp Zacher + Adams Family Doc.
CORRECTION 2026-09-22: Marriage dated 15 Aug 1897 at Lynden, WA, from the 1943 family record book.

Open question: John Jacob Kulp's birth year is 1860, 1864 or 1865; his Albion headstone says 1860, but that would make his mother Sarah Vancel about 14. No birth certificate is known [Family research emails, email 14, 23]
Open question: The Kulp lineage numbering in email 23 skips 8 and uses 9 twice (John Jacob Kulp and Elmer Spencer Kulp). The generation numbers are not reliable. [Family research emails, email 23]
Open question: John and Mary Kulp's burial place is called both 'Albion Cemetery' and 'Guy Albion Pine Cemetery'. Is this the same cemetery? [Family research emails, email 23]
Open question: Irma says it is unknown when Michael and John Kulp came to Washington. They first appear in the 1885 Washington Territory census [Family research emails, email 23]

Open question: Where were the first seven Kulp children born: Delta Township, Blaine or Lynden? Delayed certificates for Elmer and Edith say Lynden, but Irma believed the Kulp homestead on Burk Road [Family research emails, email 48]
Open question: Grandpa John Kulp's death is given as 'about 1946/7' (email 49); the tree has 11 Jan 1947. [Family research emails, email 49, 11]
